svg.text: The editor SHALL present a three-pane layout (similar to Visual Studio or Obsidi
an): left navigation tree, central graph view, and right inspector.
Provide a standalone application capable of creating and manipulating Aurora mod
els visually, reusing the aurora_shared library to facilitate development.
The editor SHALL reuse aurora_shared for model discovery/loading and validation/
rendering semantics to stay consistent with other Aurora tooling.
The standalone editor SHOULD be implemented using Dioxus as the primary UI libra
ry.
Enable rapid comprehension and editing of an Aurora model through a visual, mult
i-pane editor that reduces cognitive load and navigation friction.
The editor SHALL persist edits to model files in a safe manner that avoids parti
al writes and preserves schema validity (e.g., atomic replace per card file).
Minimize duplicated logic and inconsistencies across tooling surfaces by reusing
the aurora_shared library for model discovery, parsing, validation, and renderi
ng.
The editor SHALL provide a right-pane inspector: the top half edits the focused
card; the bottom half renders a Markdown-style view of the card (including links
). The bottom half SHALL provide a tab to reveal the card’s audit trail details.
The editor SHALL provide a central mind-map / TheBrain style view with the focus
ed card centered. The view SHALL show the parent (from the chosen shortest-path
chain), and MAY show siblings (same card_type) linked from that parent even if t
hey are not linked to the focused card.
The editor SHALL provide a left-pane tree view for navigation, where the tree is
derived from a chosen shortest path from the mission root to each card.
